blocks.content: Until now, we have visualized trees as drawings with circles (nodes) and lines (edges) connecting them. These drawings help us understand the concept, but computers don't see them this way.

In computers, trees are special structures created through data formats like arrays and vectors. These structures (known as the linked structure of trees) make trees different from other data structures.
Next, we'll break it down so that we can understand this easily.
